observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 Slim console with a black controller and power cable beside it. A manual labeled 'PlayStation5' is visible in front of the console.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a different angle, with the controller and a white box with the PlayStation logo. The console appears to be in a used condition with some dust and wear.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a screen.
No FIFA disc is visible in either photo.
The seller claims it comes with a FIFA disc game, but none is shown.

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 Slim console and controller available
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the console and controller as described.

claims.claim: it comes with FIFA disc game
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc is visible in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on and running a game, or a photo of the console's screen showing the home menu.

risks.risk: FIFA disc game may not be included or may be damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the FIFA disc and its packaging, or a video showing the disc being inserted and read.

risks.risk: Controller may have dead buttons, unresponsive sticks, or battery issues
risks.proof: Video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controller may not work

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: Photo of the console's serial number and a verification check via Sony's website or a trusted third party.

Video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
